component.name: whatsnative
component.summary: Native GTK4 + libadwaita companion messaging client for Linux

description.p: whatsnative is a compiled, zero-WebView native Linux companion messaging desktop client built with Rust, GTK4, libadwaita, SQLCipher, and XDG Desktop Portals.
Disclaimer: whatsnative is an independent third-party open-source project and is not affiliated with, authorized, maintained, sponsored, or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc.

Initial Phase 0 / Phase 1A native Linux companion release with SQLCipher encryption at rest, QR and 8-character phone-code linking, encrypted FTS5 search, XDG Portal integration, and incoming call signaling banners.
